description: This file contains functions for transforming OpenTelemetry span data into OTLP format, including functions for converting spans, links, events, and span kinds, as well as handling resource and scope categorization.

methods.name: Spans
methods.description: Transforms a slice of ReadOnlySpan into a slice of ResourceSpans in OTLP format.

methods.name: span
methods.description: Converts a single ReadOnlySpan into an OTLP Span object.

methods.name: clampUint32
methods.description: Clamps an integer value to the range of uint32.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Creates an OTLP Status object from a span status code and message.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Transforms a slice of span links into OTLP span links.

methods.name: buildSpanFlagsWith
methods.description: Builds span flags bitmask based on trace flags and parent span context.

methods.name: spanEvents
methods.description: Transforms span events into OTLP span events.

methods.name: spanKind
methods.description: Converts a trace.SpanKind into an OTLP span kind.
